meta.parties: Ramanathan Chetty v. Tambyah Et Al

rules.statement: A manual seizure under section 227 of the Civil Procedure Code must be apparent and effective to show that property is in custodia legis, and sales during such a period are void if the purchaser knew or had reason to know of the seizure.
rules.supporting_quote: "In my opinion the ship was not under seizure when sold by the judgment-debtor to Chelliah, or when sold by Chelliah to the plaintiff, and even if it were, the sale ought not to be held void under the circumstances present here, unless it is proved that the purchaser knew or had reason to know of the seizure."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 227 of the Civil Procedure Code
